'''Telosians''' were the inhabitants of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Telos IV]].<ref name="KOTOR 2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

In the year [[3958 BBY]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Saul Karath]] betrayed the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and bombarded the surface of Telos IV, killing a majority of the Telosians on the surface, including the [[Morgana Onasi|wife]] of [[Carth Onasi]].<ref name="KOTOR 1">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

After the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Telosian Restoration Project]] focused on restoring the devastated surface of Telos, and making it habitable again. At that point, the Telosions lived on the massive [[Citadel Station]] in orbit around the planet.<ref name="KOTOR 2" />

At some point, the surface was habitable again, and cities developed on the surface, including the capital city of [[Thani]].<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref><ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
